g.text: 3. If tokens ≥ 1 → consume one and allow.

g.text: - MULTI/EXEC alone is insufficient if the read occurs outside the transaction.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Two requests may read the same token count and both get allowed.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Fix: Redis Lua script performs read → refill → check → update atomically.

g.text: - Fail-open: Allow requests if limiter fails; better availability, weaker protection.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Fail-closed: Reject requests if limiter fails; stronger protection, lower availability.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Choose based on risk; protect critical backends from overload.
